comment: Harness-automation limitation, not a backend defect (BACKLOG T8). The OP correctly refuses to redirect to an unregistered redirect_uri and renders a 400 unauthorized_client error instead (OIDC Core 3.1.2.3 / 3.1.2.4). The suite's headless scripted-browser flow is built for the happy path, so its 'Verify Complete' step waits for the 'submission_complete' callback element that (correctly) never appears and times out. In a human-driven OIDF certification run this test passes. Removing this baseline once the browser flow handles the negative-redirect case is tracked in BACKLOG T8.

Companion to the oidcc-ensure-registered-redirect-uri condition above: the scripted browser's 'wait for submission_complete' task times out because the OP correctly does not redirect to the unregistered redirect_uri. Harness-automation limitation, not a backend defect (BACKLOG T8).
